mutations.name: a card that cannot show its evidence reads as a gate that needs none
kills: inbox tap on an owner-at-head merge gate offers no tap, naming the facts, the reason and the terminal command, when the card cannot show all of it

mutations.name: evidence read at another head is offered
kills: inbox tap on an owner-at-head merge gate offers no tap on evidence read at another head than the item's

mutations.name: the confirm digest leaves the evidence out
mutations.find: digestOf([item.id, action, item.hold ?? null, readBack, readAt])
mutations.replace: digestOf([item.id, action, item.hold ?? null, { ...readBack, evidence: undefined }, readAt])
kills: inbox tap on an owner-at-head merge gate refuses the confirm once the evidence changed after it was read, and writes no record

mutations.name: the record posts no evidence digest
kills: inbox tap on an owner-at-head merge gate reads back every fact's evidence and posts the record with that evidence's digest
